lines.text: Draupadi's pot was empty. And ten thousand hungry sages... were at her door.
Krishna... please. I have no one else.
He came. One leaf was stuck to the pot. He ate it... and every sage felt full.
Offer Me a leaf... a flower... a fruit... a little water... with love. I accept it.
Whatever little you have today... is enough for Him.
Comment Krishna... if you need Him today.
